prerequisites.rationale_text: Willingness to be wrong must precede the design of testable claims. Without intellectual humility, the ego barrier prevents genuine attempts at falsification — the practitioner designs tests to confirm rather than disconfirm.
prerequisites.source_quote: Falsifiability requires intellectual humility — the acknowledging of what you don't know.

curation_notes.summary: Explicit dependency. The Falsifiability article directly names intellectual humility as a requirement. The ego barrier (IH's antagonist) is the primary failure mode that prevents genuine falsification.
